items.source: Returns the type of the relationship.

If direction is Relationship.Direction.OUTGOING, than the attribute annotated with Relationship will be the target node of the relationship and the class containing the annotated attribute will be the start node.
items.translation: 如果 `direction` 为 Relationship.Direction.OUTGOING，则用 Relationship 注解的属性将成为关系的目标节点，而包含该注解属性的类将成为起始节点。

items.source: If direction is Relationship.Direction.INCOMING, than the attribute annotated with Relationship will be the start node of the relationship and the class containing the annotated attribute will be the end node.
items.translation: 如果direction为Relationship.Direction.INCOMING，则用Relationship注解的属性将作为关系的起始节点，而包含该注解属性的类将成为结束节点。

items.source:
Set this attribute to false if you don't want updates on an aggregate
root to be cascaded to related objects.
items.translation: 如果不想将聚合根上的更新级联到相关对象，请将此属性设置为 false。

items.source:
Set this attribute to false if you don't want updates on an aggregate
root to be cascaded to related objects. Be aware that in this case you are
responsible to manually save the related objects and that you might end up with a
local object graph that is not in sync with the actual graph.
items.translation: 将此属性设置为 false，如果您不希望将聚合根上的更新级联到相关对象。请注意，在这种情况下，您需要手动保存相关对象，并且最终可能会导致本地对象图与实际图不同步。

items.source:

items.translation: 是否应将拥有实体的更新级联到相关对象。
